'''Cop Wheels''' is a playably voluntary but canonically mandatory storyline mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]], accessed independently by [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] under the inspiration of blind Chinese-American [[San Fierro Triads]] leader [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]] from the administrative staff suite of the [[Four Dragons Casino]] in [[Las Venturas]].

==Mission==
Carl recently planted remotely detonated explosive charges on the main generators of [[Sherman Dam]], the central power source serving [[Las Venturas]], in order to provide a means of creating darkness and confusion while robbing the vault at [[Caligula's Palace]]. His next step in planning the heist is to seize 4 [[HPV-1000]] [[Las Venturas Police Department|police]] motorcycles to be used as outriders for the armored vehicle Carl plans to use to haul off the cash without raising suspicion. With only minutes to spare before alerting the police to activity, Carl rushes about Las Venturas, stealing the motorcycles, while Woozie's assistant drives a [[Packer]] around the [[Julius Thruway]], awaiting each bike as Carl drives it up the truck's loading ramps. After the bikes have been collected, Woozie's assistant returns them to the [[Four Dragons Casino]] to be stashed until the heist is in full swing.

==Script==
'''CJ''': Alright, here's the plan. It's all about the art of deception. While I get as much heat on me as possible, y'all get away with the green.

'''[[Zero]]''': Question - How does the Mafia normally move cash out of Caligula's?

'''CJ''': Bingo! Stripes for Mr. Zero here.

'''Custodian''': (''pats Zero hard'') Ha hey! Good job, you little ass-kisser!

'''CJ''': So we're going to steal ourselves an armored car and re-spray it so it looks like one of their regular trucks.

'''Triad''': What about the police escorts? Whenever they move cash around, they use police motorcycles as outriders.

'''CJ''': Exactly what I was thinking. C'mon, come with me, and we're gonna go get some cop wheels. (''to the Triad, outside'') You get the Packer, hit the [[Julius Thruway]] and keep moving. I'll steal the bikes and get them to you.

'''(''Carl steals four police motorcycles.'')'''

'''CJ''': OK, that should do us. Take care of those bikes. Now get out of here!

==Reward==
The reward for completing the mission is increased [[Respect]]. The mission [[Up, Up and Away!]] is unlocked by completing the mission.

==Trivia==
*The name of the mission is a possible reference to Hot Wheels.
